result.document_summary: Part 3 of 7 of Newark, NJ municipal code Title 2, Chapter 10 covering abandoned property lists, a senior homeowner emergency repair program, city-owned lot leases, and vacant and foreclosing property registration, maintenance and fee rules.
result.notes: This part contains no rules in the six in-scope categories (rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application/screening fees, screening restrictions, algorithmic rent setting). The content is about abandoned/vacant property registration and fees, foreclosure-property maintenance, a homeowner repair loan program, and garden lot leases, which are outside scope. The $1 per term rent for city-owned garden lot leases and the vacant property registration fees are not rent control or screening fees, so none were extracted.
